projects.title: AI Skin Intelligence & Personalized Skincare Planner
projects.summary: AI-powered skincare platform that analyzes skin characteristics and generates personalized skincare routines and recommendations.
projects.problem: Generic skincare recommendations often fail to account for individual skin characteristics, concerns, lifestyle, environmental factors, allergies, and previous assessments.
projects.solution: Built an AI-powered platform that combines skin image analysis, user profiles, health/lifestyle information, ingredient intelligence, and recommendation logic to generate personalized skincare routines.
features: Morning, evening, weekly, and seasonal routines

projects.title: ASHA EHR Companion
projects.summary: Offline-first mobile EHR application helping ASHA workers manage patient records and healthcare visits in areas with unreliable connectivity.
projects.problem: Healthcare workers in rural environments may need to collect and access patient information even when reliable internet connectivity is unavailable.
projects.solution: Designed an offline-first mobile EHR system with local data storage and synchronization between the mobile application and backend server.

projects.title: Full-Stack Developer Portfolio
projects.summary: This site: a modern full-stack portfolio with a managed backend and an owner-only admin dashboard, showcasing projects, skills, journey, and achievements.
projects.problem: A developer needs a professional, always-current platform to present technical capability beyond a traditional resume, and a way to update it without redeploying code.
projects.solution: Built a responsive React + TypeScript frontend backed by a FastAPI + PostgreSQL API, with JWT-secured owner-only admin for managing content, image uploads, and contact messages.
features: Responsive modern UI with light/dark themes
Automated backend, frontend, and E2E tests
